# castform compute

> run your code on gpu machines from a python script.

- [sdk overview](/docs): install, images, containers, logs, errors
- [external sandboxes](/docs/external-sandboxes.md): rl rollouts in modal, e2b, daytona, etc. that survive preemptions
- [recovery reference](/docs/castform-recovery.md): what castform.recovery (`@cr.rollout`) does, in detail
